verdict.rationale: The department's own pages say founders can file and pay New York State taxes through a free Business Online Services account. They name specific online filings: Form CT-5 via Corporation Tax Web File, and withholding returns NYS-1 and NYS-45 filed electronically. Payments can be made from a bank account or via Quick Pay. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent confirmation of the transaction flow (the /e-services/ account pages are robots-disallowed and were not fetched), and published evidence that business tax registration can also be done online.
